title: Reactive Blacklist Filter Stream
description_html:
Design a filter system that processes a stream of input values while maintaining a dynamic blacklist.

  • processFilter(value) — add/remove value from the blacklist.
  • processInput(value) — process an incoming value; if it has appeared in the input stream and is not currently blocked, call emit(value).
  • emit(value) — output a value.

Follow-up — visibility transitions

Add an updateFlag indicating whether a value should become visible or hidden:

  • processFilter(boolean updateFlag, int value) — updateFlag controls add vs remove from the filter.
  • If a filter update makes a value that has already appeared become hidden, call emit(false, value).
  • If a filter update makes a previously hidden (already-seen) value visible again, call emit(true, value).

Emit only on a genuine visibility flip of an already-seen value — updates for unseen values or no-op updates emit nothing.

Example

processFilter +1   +2        -1        +3
processInput          1            3
emit                     (1)   (-1)  (+3)...   # transitions of seen values

Design: two hash sets (seen, blocked) + reactive emit on transition (cf. LC 2694 / 705). See Notes.
